name: Yokohama Museum of Art
known: The foundation's board is headed by chairman Seiichi Kondo, with the museum's director Mika Kuraya as an executive director; its councillors include the head of the Yokohama Chamber of Commerce and Industry (annual report FY2024).

name: Amman Design Week
known: 2026 curators: Faysal Tabbarah for exhibitions, with the theme "Accumulations", and Khaled Al-Bashir for programmes (Yanko Design; e-flux for Tabbarah).

name: Darat al Funun (The Khalid Shoman Foundation)
known: Founded by the artist Suha Shoman, who from 1988 hosted exhibitions and lectures on contemporary Arab art at the Scientific and Cultural Center of the Abdul Hameed Shoman Foundation.

Khalid Shoman, the centre's patron, was the son of Arab Bank founder Abdel Hamid Shoman and Vice-Chairman of the bank's board from 1974 until he resigned in June 2001 (The Star, Amman, 5 to 11 July 2001, reproduced on the centre's site).
Rogers describes him as the centre's patron and deputy chairman of the Abdul Hameed Shoman Foundation.
Arab Bank, founded by the Shoman family, lost a 2014 US terror-financing verdict (overturned 2018).

name: Jordan National Gallery of Fine Arts
known: Founded by the Royal Society of Fine Arts, a private non-profit, and inaugurated on 19 February 1980 under the patronage of the late King Hussein and Queen Noor.
Princess Wijdan Ali was founding director and heads the gallery's board of trustees.
Khalid Khreis is director (Wikipedia, gallery site).

name: Makan Art Space
known: Founded by Ola Khalidi (Ola El-Khalidi), who opened it in April 2003 as an alternative space for young artists free of restrictions.

name: A. Kasteyev State Museum of Arts
Almaty Museum of Arts
known: Founded by the businessman and collector Nurlan Smagulov, president and founder of the Astana Group.
Founder's money: Forbes Kazakhstan (Tatyana Panchenko, 10 September 2025) quotes Smagulov: "Now our company Astana Motors finances everything" (translated from Russian).
He said ticket sales would not cover even cleaning, and that he plans to bring in other founders, sponsors and donors, a friends' club and an endowment fund from Astana Motors.

name: Tselinny Center of Contemporary Culture
known: Founded by businessman Kairat Boranbayev, who bought the former cinema in 2015 (Orda;
The artistic director is Boranbayev's daughter, Alima Kairat (Kunstkritikk).
Founder's wealth partly oil and gas; he was convicted and surrendered assets to the state.

name: National Museum of the Republic of Kazakhstan
known: A Decree of the Head of State appointed Darkhan Mynbay as director (Wikipedia).

name: Circle Art Gallery
known: Its About page names Danda Jaroljmek, Arvind Vohora and Fiona Fox as founders and says the idea was born in 2013 in a converted 1970s house in Lavington.
Jaroljmek is the director.
Founded in 2012 under director Danda Jaroljmek.

name: Kuona Collective

name: Nairobi Contemporary Art Institute
known: Programmes listed on its site: exhibitions, events, education outreach, the TURN2 curatorial residency, offsite projects, The Gathering, artist films and talks, the Ujuzi programme and publications.
Exhibitions include 60 Years: Selections from the NCAI Collection (August and September 2024), curated by Don Handa, which Contemporary And reports was free and open to the public.

name: Stacion - Center for Contemporary Art Prishtina
known: Stone House: in the courtyard of the Museum of Ethnography, renovated through a civil-public partnership with the Museum of Kosovo under its director Arber Hadri.
Boxing Club: opened in 2014 as the second space, inaugurated on 12 September 2014 with "Action Boxing Club" by Elana Katz, curated by Albert Heta (Stacion).

The Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports of the Republic of Kosovo supports the 2024 open call for curatorial research projects, "Strengthening Cultural Engagement and Artistic Growth in Kosovo (FAKRRA)", with RRIPAK, Hej Taxi, DZG and x-print (Stacion).

"Back to the Future" (2009 to 2011): the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports of Kosova, the Directorate for Culture, Youth and Sports of the Municipality of Prishtina, Kosova Foundation for Open Society, Europlakat, Banka Ekonomike, Arda Rei, Dardania Insurance Company, Kosova Art Gallery, KTV, Rr

name: Contemporary Art Platform (CAP)
known: Al-Jarida names its founder as Amer Al-Huneidi (translated from Arabic).

Al-Jarida reports that founder Amer Al-Huneidi attended the opening, and quotes UNHCR's representative in Kuwait, Nesreen Al-Rubaian, thanking him for his support of the campaign and for including it in the exhibition (translated).

name: Dar al-Athar al-Islamiyyah
known: Founded in 1983 by Sheikh Nasser Sabah al-Ahmed al-Sabah (1948 to 2020) and his wife Sheikha Hussa Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah, who is director general.
The main building holds galleries, an education wing, a conservation lab and a theatre (stated by the space).
All but 61 objects came back through a UN handover in Baghdad in September and October 1991 (Kirsty Norman, Journal of the American Institute for Conservation).
Director's Circle sponsors: KIPCO, Kuwait Petroleum Corporation and its subsidiaries, Kuwait Finance House, and seven further logos with no name (stated by the space, no years or amounts).
Sheikha Hussa Sabah Al-Salem Al-Sabah is director general.
